editor note: This reason is appropriate for a temporary term even if no permanent term is defined; for example if the need for the term no longer exists. If a permanent (replacement) term is defined, the deprecated term should reference the replacement with IAO:0100001. If no replacement is defined, it may be appropriate to reference alternative terms with oboInOwl:consider.

description: The term was created to temporarily stand in for a semantic purpose, but is no longer needed, typically due to another permanent term being defined.
